caveat: Gray areas include inherited unknown/support exclusions and must not be interpreted as model uncertainty or discovered ink. No Greek transcription or translation was attempted.
decision: Mixed regional transfer:retain seed42 baseline;native remains a contrasting reference.

observations.frag1-context1: Both models show high responses in supplied-background regions and uneven response on the supplied stroke. Neither is a reliable qualitative reading here.
observations.frag1-context2: Native raises response along several supplied strokes while lowering some off-stroke patches, consistent with higher AP.
observations.frag2-context1: Native changes background/stroke contrasts but the supplied stroke remains uneven; the numerical gain does not imply complete text recovery.
observations.frag2-context2: Native more strongly follows portions of the supplied large stroke while also raising some background; raw ranking metrics improve.
observations.frag3-context1: Both maps follow parts of the upper supplied strokes; native raises substantial supplied-background regions and lowers some strong seed42 responses. AP rises but AUC falls.
observations.frag3-context2: Native suppresses several lower supplied strokes relative to seed42 while elevating broad upper/background regions. This is consistent with the independently measured ranking regression; physical cause is not identified.

scope: All six whole-context fixed-scale panels viewed; qualitative comparison only, no new masks,crops,modelcalls or metric selection.
